messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD #PD-8429 - High 5xx rate
incident-bot: Metric: inference-gateway.prod.request_5xx_rate > 8% for 3m (current 13.2%)
incident-bot: Affected regions: us-west1, eu-west1
incident-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx
incident-bot: PagerDuty link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8429

maria-sre: ack'ing and taking lead :raised_hand:

maria-sre: quick check — viewing logs, lots of upstream 502s to model-proxy v2
maria-sre: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T02:12:05Z gateway us-west1 req=abcd1234 status=502 upstream=proxy-v2 instance=proxy-07
2026-03-17T02:12:06Z gateway us-west1 req=abcd1235 status=502 upstream=proxy-v2 instance=proxy-07
```

david-oncall: seeing same in eu-west1, errored requests spiked after deploy at 02:05 UTC

maria-sre: rolling back last proxy canary on us-west1 to previous image (tag: proxy-v2 -> proxy-v1)

david-oncall: started rollback on eu-west1

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation scheduled in 10m if unack remains

maria-sre: also temporarily routing traffic away from proxy-07 (flapping instance) to warm pool

tara-pm: any customer impact? from metrics it looks like increased latency+errors for streaming endpoints

maria-sre: early check — top 3 customers with elevated 5xx:
- acme-inc: high error ratio on /v1/stream
- atlas-app: intermittent 502s
- internal-eval: degraded

maria-sre: contacting SRE on-call to confirm mitigation and SMT (sending note to ops rotation)

ops-rotation: on it, confirming we've warmed additional pools and bumped replicas +2 in us-west1

david-oncall: rollback finished in eu-west1, preflight tests show 200s on sample calls

maria-sre: us-west1 rollback complete, overall 5xx dropping, currently 6.1% (was 13.2%)

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-8429 acknowledged by maria-sre

tara-pm: will notify affected customers via status page with ETA for full recovery ~15-20m. Draft msg:
"We've identified intermittent 5xx errors affecting streaming inference in US and EU regions. Engineers have rolled back a recent proxy canary and are scaling warm pools; traffic is stabilizing. We will update in 20 minutes."

maria-sre: agreed, publish that. Also adding postmortem owners: maria-sre + david-oncall

david-oncall: leaving a note to investigate canary gating for proxy deploys and add circuit-breaker tighter thresholds

maria-sre: closing watch — last 5xx rate 2.8% baseline post-mitigations

incident-bot: PD-8429 resolved by maria-sre

maria-sre: thanks everyone :tada:
